title: Roosevelt, the CWA and regular band work again
summary: Pay stayed a dollar until Roosevelt's election, when the CWA and similar programs brought regular band work at clubs for four dollars from eight to two.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: The Depression years and the WPA band
